run_lammps_with_fairchem: run a LAMMPS simulation using a FairChem MLIP predictor with a given input script path and task name
FixExternalCallback: create a LAMMPS fix external callback that computes MLIP forces and energy from a FairChem predictor
atomic_data_from_lammps_data: build an AtomicData object from LAMMPS atom positions, atomic numbers, cell, and periodicity data
lookup_atomic_number_by_mass: lookup atomic numbers by their closest matching atomic masses with a 0.1 tolerance
separate_run_commands: separate LAMMPS run commands from the rest of an input script into two lists
